validity_notes: VN-B1 unsatisfiable_sampling_frame: The frozen design's input pool is empty (spec.json.target_pool.seeds=[], confirmed_deep_items=[], confirmed_deep_hosts=[]). VN-V2 requires 'Target pool of seed URLs is frozen at DESIGN time (recorded in spec.json.target_pool)' and the prereg section 6.1 requires the hop-confirmation crawl and pool freeze during DESIGN. Neither was recorded. There is no pool to measure; the measurement transaction is BLOCKED at its input.

VN-B2 pre_freeze_certificate_absent: VN-V9 and prereg section 14 require a live pre-freeze control certificate (pool DEEP admission, channel probeability, null control) recorded in spec.json.pre_freeze_control_certificate BEFORE freeze.json exists. The frozen record has all_verified=false, verified_at=null, evidence_refs=[]. The freeze therefore violated the frozen design's own gating rule ('Freeze proceeds ONLY if all three are verified' — prereg section 14).

VN-B3 admission_gate_non_evaluable: ADMISSION_GATE_V2 requires >=10 admitted DEEP items total with >=2 hosts/engines each holding >=3 admitted DEEP items, 'Verified during DESIGN and recorded in pre_freeze_control_certificate'. The frozen record holds 0 items and 0 hosts; the gate is non-evaluable, not failed.

VN-B4 falsifier_unreachable_both_directions: decision_rule.primary_metric = count(DEEP items reachable in <=K GETs via ANY channel) / count(admitted DEEP items in frozen pool). As frozen the denominator is 0, so the fraction is 0/0 (undefined). Neither the SUPPORTS branch (fraction >= 0.50 on >=2 engines) nor the FALSIFIES branch (fraction < 0.50 on >=2 engines) is arithmetically reachable on the frozen record; the falsifier is satisfiable in NEITHER direction until a frozen pool exists. This is exactly the empty-accept-region/unsatisfiable-predicate failure class the director mandate (agent_priors_used[8]) warns about.

VN-B5 per_engine_metric_non_computable: discovery_reachable_fraction_per_engine requires at least one host with admitted DEEP items. Zero hosts exist in the frozen record; engines_meeting_threshold cannot be counted.

VN-B6 positive_control_evidence_absent: PC_DISCOVERY_CHANNEL_REACHABILITY requires evidence (HTTP status, content-type, parsed entry count) recorded in spec.json.pre_freeze_control_certificate. The frozen certificate holds no evidence of any kind.

VN-B7 no_post_freeze_pool_construction: This EXECUTE did not construct a pool, run a hop-confirmation crawl, or probe discovery channels live after freeze. Doing so would create the sampling frame after the freeze timestamp, mutating the frozen design's input (VN-V2: pool frozen at DESIGN time) and rendering any downstream number non-confirmatory under the packet contract (prereg section 19: 'Any post-freeze analysis changes render the confirmatory claim exploratory'). No live measurement was therefore taken.

VN-B8 baselines_unpaired: B_LINK_FOLLOWING_BFS, B_PERSISTED_PATH_REACQUISITION and B_DIRECT_URL_REPLAY are carried from EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378. They cannot be re-measured or paired to this experiment because this experiment's frozen item set is empty; the parent DEEP band (single-host/single-engine doc.rust-lang.org mdBook) is explicitly rejected as a substitute for the required >=2-engine pool (parent handoff carry_forward and dependencies).

VN-B9 environment_viable: Outbound TCP 443 connectivity to candidate hosts succeeded (OBS-ENV-01), so the BLOCKED status is NOT an infrastructure/network failure of the substrate class. The blocker is the unsatisfiable frozen design, not the network.
